senses.gloss: m. collect. noun (זא, cmp. מוֹזָא; Syr. pl. מזא, P. Sm. 2064) hair.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 21:12">Targ. Y. Deut. XXI, 12</cite>.—
<cite ref="Nazir 39a:4">Naz. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>האי מ׳ וכ׳</he> (Rashi <cite ref="B00655"><he>בינתא</he></cite>) does hair grow from beneath or from above?—
<cite ref="Megillah 18a:27">Meg. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה מהפך במַזְיֵיה</he> was busying himself with his hair; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 26b">R. Hash. 26ᵇ</cite> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בשעריה</he>).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 110a:1">Snh. 110ᵃ</cite> top <he>סתרתה למַזְיָהּ</he> she loosened her hair.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 110a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>גייז ליה למִיזְיֵיכוּ</he> he cut your hair off (shaved you all over).

Ab. Zar. 75ᵃ דמ׳ (filters made) of human hair.—[Targ. Is. III, 20 קולמז מסיא (קולמן ed. Lag.), Var. קלמסמסיא, קול מזמסיא, Ar. קלמזמ׳, read: קוּלְמְסֵי מַזְיָא hair-pins (h. text קשרים; LXX ἐμπλόκιον; cmp. LXX Ex. XXXV, 22.]
